_doc: Hollowmere, the Saltwright flotilla, at dawn in the fog (its first visit, Ch15; Act III's zone): gulls work the raft-city and stand on the dock's piles (tops y 2.7), and a shoal of small fish turns in the open water south of the dock, east of the moored ship (the surface y -0.25, the bed y -1.6). After Ansedra's birdless stillness (bible §5.8, ADR 0204 §1) the flotilla is where life comes back: hull-houses, windmills, tide-wheels, gulls (hollowmere.md: warmth returns). Act I's own gull and fish kinds; placed on the greybox layout (hollowmere_layout.json), to re-seat on the dressed kit with tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd.
